name: Keycloak admin CLI (kcadm)
description: Installs a Keycloak admin CLI as kcadm: the official kcadm.sh (with a headless JRE) at an exact version, checked against a sha256 you supply, or a small curl wrapper around the Admin REST API. The two flavors share the name, not the syntax. There are no default pins.

flavor.description: official: Keycloak's kcadm.sh, pinned, needs Java. rest: a curl wrapper, kcadm METHOD PATH [JSON], no pin. Set it here, or as CLI_KEYCLOAK_FLAVOR in the image environment, or in the pins file. Empty everywhere means official.

version.description: official only: Keycloak version to install (e.g. 26.7.5). Set it with its sha256 here, or as CLI_KEYCLOAK_VERSION in the image environment, or in the pins file. There is no default.

sha256.description: official only: sha256 of keycloak-<version>.tar.gz (the same file on every arch). Set it here, or as CLI_KEYCLOAK_SHA256 in the image environment, or in the pins file, in the same place as the version.

pins_file.description: Path of the pins file in the image, read when neither the options nor the image environment set the flavor or a pin. Empty means /etc/devcontainer-features/pins.env.

install_jre.description: official only: install the distro's headless JRE (default-jre-headless, Java 21 on Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04). Turn it off if the image already has Java 21 or newer. Ignored for rest.
